_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Fear & Greed ~48 and flat 30d tape sit in/near Complacency with offsetting flows and liquidity so the coil default is HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly forwards Complacency/HOLD; narrative offers no forward phase call, only cross-asset rotation color
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC 30d stays inside roughly ±2% and Fear & Greed holds 42-54 while ETF flows remain suppressed
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows rebound sharply with Fear & Greed breaking above 62, or a flush takes Fear & Greed under 39 with funding turning negative
